canonicalization: Repository CanonicalBytes ordering; compact UTF-8 JSON; every domain prefix includes one raw NUL byte. Payload hashes omit only record.payload_hash. A logical_period_id close key is decimal term_version + ":" + decimal period_index; both fields use canonical nonnegative decimal strings, making the delimiter unambiguous. Period-resolution commands use the family-scoped logical_period_id key (`term_version:period_index`); family keeps resolver and close identities separate.

cases.rule: An empty M4 history receives an explicitly anchored initial term and a persisted period-zero boundary resolution; both immutable records, the saved response, and the cross-stream cut are exact.
Organization fiscal-calendar setup stores a new immutable version and cannot change customer billing terms.

A persisted initial term and period-zero resolution precede the basis/activity writes. Activity is nonmonetary; a semantic retry only reserves its delivery ID; the pre-close delta changes the open-period aggregate; close rounds aggregate E(3)=3/2 once using nearest_ties_away.

A persisted initial term and period-zero resolution precede the correction. Before durable close, the correction may be accepted after the scheduled period end, is assigned to the original period, and owns the exact rate-times-delta amount.
After durable close, the correction support record is nonmonetary and a linked adjustment owns the exact signed rate-times-delta amount in the acceptance-time period.

The post-lock sampled transition instant clips the still-open predecessor, preserves that logical period, and appends both the superseding predecessor resolution and the successor term period-zero resolution.
The first standard close atomically includes each eligible unclaimed adjustment and creates its one presentation claim; later ad hoc issue cannot present it again.
An empty period 1 is durably resolved in its own atomic command and snapshot before close; exact close retry returns the saved empty statement without new records or a torn cut.
